description.narrative: The PDO is to increase the Agri-food system's resilience to climate change and strengthen food safety and quality.The proposed Additional Financing (AF) aims to accelerate and expand the adoption of Conservation Agriculture (CA) by reducing farmers' production costs and offering commercial incentives. While large-scale farmers are increasingly adopting CA, particularly small and medium-scale farmers face adoption constraints such as temporary yield reductions, limited access to specialized equipment, and low access to climate-resilient seeds. The parent operation addresses supply-side adoption constraints, while the AF focuses on boosting farmer buy-in (with a focus on small and medium-scale farmers) by reducing production costs and increasing farm profitability. The AF will be implemented in the Rabat Sale-Kenitra region (RSK) through the Regional Directorate of Agriculture of MAPMDREF (DRA RSK) as the implementing agency. New activities under the AF focused on accelerating the adoption of CA and boosting farmers resilience and incomes by using an innovative e-voucher scheme, which provides in-kind incentives (seeds and direct seeding services) to farmers at different stages of CA adoption during three consecutive agricultural campaigns. It is anticipated that farmers continue practicing CA practices even after the phase-out of incentives reducing production costs given improved yields and incomes. In addition, the project will improve market access by supporting the aggregation and commercialization of crops. A special focus is placed on strengthening youth-led advisory and mechanization services through capacity building and formalization to encourage youth employment in agriculture. Project activities will be implemented through a private operator (an aggregator) recruited by the DRA RSK. In addition, the DRA RSK will equip publicly acquired direct seeders with GPS devices to track their deployment and maintenance, which will facilitate the evaluation of ongoing efforts to scale up CA in the target region.The DRA RSK will recruit operational Technical Assistance (TA) to ensure adequate project management and monitoring (including through close supervision of the private operator). The TA will support the DRA RSK to define technical data on project beneficiaries, train PIU staff on data management, and support institutional learning.
The PDO is to increase the resilience of Morocco's agri-food systems to climate, sanitary and market risks.
